text: かわいそーな　ことに　この　いえは　ドロボーに　はいられたんだ！

structure.jp: かわいそーな　ことに
ドロボーに　はいられたんだ！
structure.en: was broken into by a burglar!

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: ドロボーに　はいられた
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb says the thing was done to someone, and に shows who did it. Here it also hints that the house suffered from it. ドロボーに　はいられた = 'was broken into by a burglar'.

patterns.name: 〜ことに
patterns.span: かわいそーな　ことに
patterns.explanation: A feeling word plus ことに at the start tells how the speaker feels about what he is going to say. かわいそーな　ことに = 'sadly'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the short form of のだ and makes the sentence sound like an explanation of the situation. はいられたんだ = 'you see, it was broken into'.
